mentions.name: PM contribution transition tool
mentions.description: This tool aims to make product managers' contributions easier to transition into software engineering, streamlining the handoff from PM work to engineering work.
mentions.problem: PM contributions are difficult to transition into software engineering.
mentions.source_excerpt: After working with so many PM's I am working on a way to make their contributions easier to transition into software engineering.
mentions.author: bryan_specgit
